name: @form-create/designer
description: Vue 3 low-code form designer plugin built with Vite/Vue CLI tooling, Element Plus UI components, @form-create dynamic form engine, vuedraggable, and related editors (CodeMirror, signature pad). The entry (src/index.js) registers the FcDesigner component and supporting widgets (drag tools, editors, tables, subforms) while exposing extension hooks for menus, drag rules, localization, and utility helpers; configuration modules define palette categories and component rules, utilities handle JSON/template generation, localization, and clipboard helpers, and types/ provides TypeScript declarations. Key features include a drag-and-drop builder with left palette and tree view, central design canvas, right-side property/style/event/validation panels, preview modes (form/component/html), JSON and locale editors, multi-language support, and advanced widgets such as table forms, signatures, and grouped/subform layouts.

naming.files: kebab-case for components, camelCase for utilities

structure.src/config: Configuration for palette categories and component rules
structure.src/utils: Utility helpers for JSON/template generation, localization, clipboard
